title: MediaClinic Settings
description: Schema for settings.json written by mediaclinic/settings_controller.py

last_folder.description: First library folder (kept for compatibility with v0.18.x)

last_results.description: Deprecated since v0.18.3 — scan results now live in last_results.json next to this file; key kept empty for compatibility

sort_spec.description: v0.19.3 B63: sort levels (key + direction), level 1 first; sort_option is still written for older versions

sort_presets.description: v0.19.3 B63: the user's own sort presets

ui_language.description: v0.20.0 UI1a: the interface language the user picked. No default: absent = follow Windows (Portuguese → pt_BR, Spanish → es, other → en)

lang_ok_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the Lang OK? column

fanarttv_client_key.description: Optional fanart.tv VIP client key (v0.19.1 I10)

default_browser.description: Path to browser exe; empty = system default

poster_quality_level.description: Mirror of health_rules.poster_folder_quality_level since v0.19.0 (Health Rules are authoritative)

fanart_accept_168.description: Accept 16:8 (~1.50) ratio as valid for fanart

poster_accept_34.description: Accept 3:4 (0.75) ratio as valid for poster/folder

column_widths.description: Persisted column widths keyed by column id (string → integer pixels)

scan_workers.description: Parallel workers for listing, image and metadata phases (v0.18.4)

ffprobe_workers.description: Parallel ffprobe processes during video phases (v0.18.4)

hidden_columns.description: Column ids hidden via Tools → Choose Columns (v0.18.4); the Library column is hidden by default (v0.19.0)

library_folders.description: Library (root) folders, scanned into one table; migrated from last_folder on the first v0.19.0 run (v0.19.0)

library_filter.description: Library shown and scanned; empty = all libraries (v0.19.0)

window_geometry.description: Saved size/position per window id (class name, plus a suffix for shared classes such as TextReportDialog:<stem>) (v0.19.0)

ffprobe_cache_enabled.description: v0.19.1: remember FFprobe results in ffprobe_cache.json (path + size + mtime); unchanged videos are not probed again

ffmpeg_frame_timeout_sec.description: v0.19.2 B28: seconds one frame of 'Frames from movie' may take before FFmpeg is stopped

ctx_repeat_last.description: v0.19.2 B57: show 'Repeat: <last action>' at the top of the right-click menu

check_updates.description: v0.19.2 B50: check GitHub for a new release at start, at most once a day (status-bar link only)

last_update_check.description: v0.19.2 B50: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last automatic update check

skipped_version.description: v0.19.2 B50: a release the user chose to skip (no status-bar link for it)

dark_title_bar.description: v0.19.2 B51: dark Windows title bars on every MediaClinic window (applied at once)

scan_ignored_report.description: v0.19.2 B53: show the 'Ignored folders' window after a scan that did not add some folders

library_kinds.description: v0.19.4 I19: {library path: 'movies' | 'series'}; a path not listed is 'movies' (series from v0.22)

health_mode.description: v0.19.6 TR1b: what the health check and the fixes use. nfo: the .nfo files (Kodi, Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Infuse), movie.xml ignored; nfo_xml: both; xml: movie.xml only (MediaBrowser, Media Center Master), the NFO ignored. Settings from an older version get nfo_xml

health_preset.description: v0.20.0 HP1d: the health preset; a new user starts with tight, an existing user gets the preset their rules equal, else custom

media_programs.description: v0.20.0 F3: the programs that play the movies (Settings → Health Rules, tick boxes); they set health_mode and the names a fix writes. [] = not chosen: the health mode stays, a fix keeps each folder's names

library_programs.description: v0.20.0 F3: {library path key: [programs]} = Libraries… → Programs… for that library; a path not listed follows media_programs (library_nfo_only true still leaves out MediaBrowser / Media Center Master)

health_mode_asked.description: v0.19.6 TR1b: the question at the start (three buttons) was answered; closing it asks again at the next start

first_start_pending.description: v0.20.0 6g (I34): true only for a new user (no settings.json yet) until Start in the first-start window (language, movies folder, programs, strictness, FFprobe)

plex_nfo_checks.description: v0.20.0 6h: Plex reads no NFO and no collections (tested). With only Plex ticked for a library: 'off' = the NFO and collection checks are off, 'on' = kept, '' = not asked yet (kept); asked once in a pop-up, changed in Settings → Health Rules

programs_asked.description: v0.20.0 6g: the first-start question 'Which programs play your movies?' was answered (Start, Save or Not now); closing the window asks again at the next start

library_inactive.description: v0.20.0 5j: {library path key: true} = the library is unticked in Libraries…: not scanned, its rows hidden from the table and the counters but kept

library_nfo_only.description: v0.19.6 TR1: {library path: true (NFO files only: the movie.xml checks are off there) | false (the user said no)}; a path not listed was not asked yet

movie_panel_shown.description: v0.19.4 L3: the selected-movie panel right of the table (Hide / Ctrl+B)

movie_panel_width.description: v0.19.4 L3: width of the selected-movie panel in px

group_by_collection.description: v0.19.4 B110h: the movie table grouped by collection (view only)

collection_name_lang.description: v0.19.4 P4: a collection's name language: auto (English unless more than half of its local titles are in another language) or a fixed language code

collection_folder.description: v0.19.4 B110g: Kodi's Movie set information folder (collection artwork); empty = off

settings_migrations.description: v0.19.2 B35: one-time settings migrations already done (internal, e.g. b35_folder_rules_off)

ffmpeg_run_budget_sec.description: v0.19.2 B28: seconds one 'Frames from movie' run may take in total

api_pauses.description: v0.19.1: per-service pause after a rate limit / daily limit / repeated server error; written only when a pause starts or ends, expired entries dropped on start

export_prefs.description: Last choices of the Export Movie List dialog (v0.18.3): preset, fields, format, scope

columns_introduced.description: v0.20.1 AC1: the columns new in a version whose default visibility was already decided once (the Actors column: visible only with Kodi ticked)

artwork_language.description: v0.20.1 TF3: the language artwork is fetched in — 'library' (the Lang OK? language) or an ISO 639-1 code

artwork_language_mode.description: v0.20.1 TF3: prefer the language (then no text, English, the rest) or only that language

artwork_textless_backgrounds.description: v0.20.1 TF3: fanart and backdrops without text first, then the artwork language

image_fix_prefs.description: v0.19.2 F4: last choices of Fix image proportions / size — method per kind (poster_method, fanart_method), ai_upscale, and the result of the upscaler GPU test

health_rules.description: Configurable health rule engine settings (v0.18.2, extended v0.18.3)

single_source_level.description: v0.19.1: how a movie with only an IMDb or only a TMDb ID is reported

no_source_level.description: v0.19.1: how a movie with no IMDb and no TMDb ID is reported

profile_names_unread.description: v0.20.0 F3c: with programs ticked (Settings → Health Rules), warn when the NFO, poster or fanart has a name a ticked program does not read (e.g. Infuse and poster.jpg); on in every preset

no_actor_info.description: v0.20.1 AC2: warn when the NFO has no actor information (with Kodi: only web links for the photos); on only in the Tight preset

collection_set_nfo.description: v0.20.1 CF2: check each collection folder's set.nfo (Kodi); off in the Easy preset

missing_folder.description: v0.19.2 B35: off by default (no media server needs folder.jpg)

folder_optional_with_kodi_poster.description: v0.19.1: no 'Missing folder image' when a Kodi-style poster (<video>-poster.jpg/png, .tbn) exists

xml_tags_old_readers.description: v0.20.0 KR1.4: warn when movie.xml has an IMDb / TMDB ID or the votes only in tags the MediaBrowser / Emby parser ignores (<IMDB_ID>, <TMDB>, <Votes>); Auto Repair adds <IMDbId> / <TMDbId> / <VoteCount>

id_not_kodi.description: v0.20.0 KR1.1: warn when an NFO has an IMDb / TMDB ID only in <imdbid> / <tmdbid> (Kodi reads <uniqueid>); Auto Repair adds <uniqueid>

nfo_name_not_kodi.description: v0.19.1: warn when the NFO exists only as <folder>.nfo and Kodi (which reads <video>.nfo / movie.nfo) would not find it

nfo_online_art_links.description: v0.20.0 RD9: warn when the NFO links artwork online (<thumb> / <fanart><thumb> URLs) that the folder has as a local file; off in every preset; the fix removes those links

nfo_unescaped_amp.description: v0.19.2 B33: warn when the NFO holds a bare '&' (Kodi accepts it, Jellyfin may ignore the whole NFO); Auto Repair escapes it

multiple_nfo_files.description: v0.19.2 F5: warn when the folder holds more than one NFO the servers read (movie.nfo is used first)

poster_missing_with_folder.description: v0.19.2 F5: also warn 'Missing poster' when folder.jpg exists (Kodi, Jellyfin, Emby and Plex use it as the poster)

image_file_too_small.description: Warning when poster/folder/fanart is below min_*_kb (v0.19.0)

image_format_mismatch.description: Warning when the image signature differs from the extension, e.g. PNG named .jpg (v0.19.0)

poster_folder_identical.description: v0.19.2 B35: off by default (servers use one of the two images)

genre_only_in_xml.description: NFO has no <genre> tags while the XML has genres (v0.19.1)

genre_only_in_nfo.description: XML has no <Genre> tags while the NFO has genres (v0.19.1)

collection_artwork.description: v0.19.4 B110g: collection folder / poster / fanart missing (only while a collection folder is set)

collection_mismatch.description: v0.19.4 B110c: TMDB lists a collection the NFO misses or names differently; one collection written two ways

title_sync_default.description: v0.19.3 B60: Repair All, when it is unclear which local title is right: keep the NFO title, or skip and report

nfo_id_tags.description: v0.20.0 RD12: the ID tags written in the NFO: every tag style (<id>, <uniqueid>, <imdbid>, <id moviedb>), or <uniqueid> only (the ID tags the NFO has are still corrected, none is added, no empty placeholder); movie.xml is not affected

id_format_invalid.description: v0.19.3 I8: an IMDb ID that is not tt + 7-9 digits, or a TMDb ID that is not a number

year_premiered_differ.description: v0.19.5 B126: NFO year against the year of premiered

year_out_of_range.description: v0.19.3 I8: a year before 1888 or after next year + 1

numeric_field_invalid.description: v0.19.3 I8: runtime / votes not a whole number, rating not on a 0-10 scale

duplicate_single_tag.description: v0.19.3 I8: a tag that should appear once appears more often

unexpected_root.description: v0.19.3 I8: NFO root not <movie>, XML root not <Item> or <Title>
